name: socialsight
description: SocialSight MCP skills for importing media, generating video, and writing full photographic prompts for image generation.

interface.shortDescription: Generate images and video through SocialSight MCP
interface.longDescription: SocialSight skills turn an agent into a production client of the SocialSight MCP server. Import URLs and local files into media_id values, discover live model constraints, quote credits, submit image and video jobs, and write full photographic prompts. There is no CLI variant — the MCP server is the only transport.
defaultPrompt: Import this product photo URL and generate a studio shot
Make an 8-second video from this still
Quote the credit cost for this Seedance clip before submitting
Write a lifestyle product photo prompt and generate it
